visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark hair, wearing a black beanie and an oversized black hoodie, stands in a brightly lit Calvin Klein outlet store. She stands before a mirror and wall-mounted racks filled with grey and white bras and underwear. She uses her right hand to point at the products and pick them up, comparing different strap designs and cup depths. The background features aisles of retail boxes and the legs of other shoppers in the distance. (2) The scene transitions to a white-walled fitting room. The woman holds her smartphone up to the mirror in a selfie position, filming her reflection. She has partially lifted her hoodie to reveal a grey CK sports bra she is testing. She adjusts the garment with her hands, showing the fit from the front and side angles. The lighting is flat and bright indoor light.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們現在在西雅圖的outlet. [Slogan]: 30% off. (2) [Subtitle]: 因為我想要買灰色的. (3) [Subtitle]: 它有分這種肩帶是CK. (4) [Subtitle]: 肩帶這種沒有CK的. (5) [Subtitle]: 它的深度也不一樣哦. (6) [Subtitle]: 這個是V到底了. (7) [Subtitle]: 深到底了 然後這個是到這邊而已. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以我在想我要買哪一種. (9) [Subtitle]: 而且它這邊沒有在幫人家測三圍的. (10) [Subtitle]: 它只能自己進去fitting room試. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以我現在去試穿吧. (12) [Subtitle]: 試穿. (13) [Subtitle]: 它好像沒有很集中其實. (14) [Subtitle]: 因為它也不是很厚的襯墊. (15) [Subtitle]: 就是它也沒有那種集中托高. (16) [Subtitle]: 就真的很美式. (17) [Subtitle]: 就是讓胸部呈現最自然 的狀態. (18) [Subtitle]: 然後我問她有沒有 XS. (19) [Subtitle]: 她說沒有 最小就S號. (20) [Subtitle]: 因為這裡是美國. (21) [Subtitle]: 她們的size都很大. (22) [Subtitle]: 不管了 那就選這個吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in a lively, conversational tone, detailing a shopping experience. An electronic pop track with a female vocal and a prominent 4/4 synthetic beat plays in the background. The acoustic space is wide, containing the low-level hum of a retail store and distant, indistinct chatter. (2) The acoustic texture shifts as the speaker enters a fitting room; the environment sounds more enclosed with tighter, short-duration reverberation. The female voice continues her critique of the clothing item with consistent volume and clarity. The background music persists at the same tempo but feels more filtered through the enclosed space.
